nodes.label: Go-Live Checklist (COSE DA FARE PRE LOGIN)
nodes.rationale: The code is a technical release-candidate (~75% toward public MVP); what blocks go-live is almost never application code but three external integrations (email, phone, legal), prod infrastructure and legal compliance.

nodes.label: Real Email Provider (Resend/Brevo authenticated SMTP)
nodes.rationale: Named the single highest-impact first step: it alone unlocks email verification, password reset, contact forwarding and notifications. In production the app refuses to start if SMTP is localhost/smtp.invalid or credentials are missing - a deliberate gate.

nodes.label: PHONE_VERIFICATION_ENABLED Flag (email-only contact)
nodes.rationale: Deliberate choice: email-only contact now, SMS (Twilio Verify) later. With the flag off (default in prod) OTP endpoints return 503, the listing form hides the phone contact, and submit-for-review forces email contact so no unverified phone number is ever published.

nodes.label: Legal Pages + Cookie Banner (/privacy, /cookie, /termini)
nodes.rationale: GDPR draft texts shipped with in-page 'to be validated' notices; owner must have a consultant validate them and fill in data-controller placeholders before opening to the public.

nodes.label: Email Verification Gate on Publication
nodes.rationale: Deliberate trade-off for less friction: login stays free of email verification, but submitDraftForReview rejects when email_verified_at is null (no extra query - the field is read in the draft fetch). The web submit panel warns, disables submit and offers a resend-email button.

nodes.label: Active Session Management UI (list + selective revoke)
Google OAuth Login (Authorization Code + PKCE, flag-gated)
nodes.rationale: Scaffolded behind GOOGLE_OAUTH_ENABLED (off by default, endpoints return 503) because the real round-trip with Google cannot be tested without credentials. Flow: /auth/oauth/google/start (state+PKCE+nonce in Redis) -> callback (code exchange -> userinfo -> find-or-create user + identity in new oauth_identities table, session, one-time handoff) -> finish; web button gated by NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_OAUTH_ENABLED.

nodes.label: GDPR Data Lifecycle (export + account deletion)
nodes.rationale: Data portability via GET /users/me/export and web download /api/account/export; right-to-erasure via DELETE me which anonymizes email/data and revokes sessions. Retention policy for logs/audit/backups still to be defined by owner/legal.

nodes.label: MFA for Admin/Moderator Roles
nodes.rationale: Code search for mfa/totp/2fa found no implementation although docs require MFA for internal roles; the fast no-code fix is Cloudflare Access + MFA on the admin domain, with app-level TOTP as an optional later step.

nodes.label: Real Observability (OpenTelemetry export, dashboards, alerts)
nodes.rationale: Needed because today health/metrics/alerts are only in-memory and local; plan is OTel export to Azure Monitor/Dynatrace with p95/p99 dashboards and alerts on 5xx, failed logins, anomalous 429s, worker queues and admin actions.

nodes.label: Domain + Cloudflare Edge (DNS/TLS for www, api, media, admin)
nodes.rationale: Dev currently runs on temporary Azure URLs + r2.dev; the adottaungatto.it domain and edge perimeter (including Cloudflare Access on admin) are not yet configured.

nodes.label: Backup / PITR + Tested Restore
nodes.rationale: Backups and PITR must be active in prod and a restore tested at least once, with a rollback runbook distinguishing app rollback from destructive-migration recovery.
